description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, cast Witness Protection by paying {U}, attaching it to Medomai.
Declare Medomai as an attacker, as it does not have its restriction due to Witness Protection.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Witness Protection and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.name: Medomai the Ageless
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent
